citation.authors: Coogan PF, Rosenberg L, Palmer JR, Cozier YC et al

record.population: 50,543 Black women, Black Women's Health Study; 2,311 breast cancers
record.finding: Heavy use of relaxers gave a hazard ratio for breast cancer of 1.13 (95% CI 0.96-1.33), not significant. For heavy use of lye-containing relaxers the hazard ratio for ER-positive breast cancer was 1.32 (0.97-1.80), also not significant. The authors call the results largely null.
